sloka: प्रविष्टौ आश्रमपदम् सीतया सह भार्यया ।द्रष्टुम् भवन्तम् आयातौ शुश्रूषार्थम् अरिन्दमौ ॥३-१२-८॥
transliteration: praviṣṭau āśramapadam sītayā saha bhāryayā ।draṣṭum bhavantam āyātau śuśrūṣārtham arindamau ॥3-12-8॥

translations.english: Both the subduers of enemies have come here now to see and serve your Holiness. You may order what is to be done next.
